headline: Fronts Roar as Bases Trade Hands Across Six Sectors
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the tempo of base turnover has quickened on the bloodiest fronts. Weathered Expanse remains the war's graveyard, its toll climbing to 166,986 Colonial and 183,512 Warden dead with eleven ownership changes in the past day; both casualty streams and enlistments are now accelerating. Linn Mercy continues to drive the heaviest fighting around Lathair and Rotdust, logging twenty flips, 53,156 Colonial and 66,553 Warden casualties, while recruitment surges. Stonecradle's activity has risen to seventeen flips, Colonial losses at 48,539 and Warden at 60,171, with casualties and sign‑ups both accelerating. Stlican Shelf reports four flips, casualties climbing to 53,681 Colonial and 59,793 Warden, and accelerating Warden loss rates. Deadlands adds five flips, its 24‑hour toll reaching 97,922 Colonial and 136,255 Warden dead, with both sides' loss rates accelerating. Mooring County holds three flips but shows a steep 24‑hour rise of 15,722 Colonial and 13,006 Warden dead, enlistments also accelerating. Quiet northern Warden‑held sectors and deep Colonial interiors report no ownership changes.
